posts.author: jrburns47
posts.content_md:
Of course you think this is a good idea - you suggested it![😂](https://holographyforum.org//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f602.svg)!

I definitely support it. Speaking only for myself, i haven’t been depressed at all during the last few months. I’m used to not getting much positive feedback about what I do and it’s been a wonderful opportunity to get a lot of small but important studio work done as well as being an environmentally beneficial time with much less traffic and social noise except the usual political noise. I miss regular physical interaction with friends but that’s slowly coming back as we all knew it would. Looking forward to reading ideas here on making such an online holozoom meeting meaningful.

posts.author: Din
posts.content_md: We've been "zooming" with friends and family. But, neither of us has a Zoom account. Joy has a work account, but it wouldn't be appropriate to use a work account for personal communications. However, we've discovered that without a Zoom account, "zooming" only lasts 45 minutes. Sometimes, they seem to adhere to it, and sometimes they don't. But, if anyone is interested, and has a Zoom account, we can go on beyond 45 minutes.

posts.author: admin_jsfisher
posts.content_md: The 40-minute meeting limit with the free version of Zoom wouldn't be a big limitation. Think of it as simply a 40-minute hard stop for each session (and truly longer sessions can be split into multiple parts). Schedule sessions on hour boundaries thereby giving everyone a 20-minute break between sessions.
